facts: Gate 2 requires a true cross-process restart replay over one fixed durable gap-repair checkpoint.
This branch adds a deterministic subprocess acceptance test that executes gap_repair in two distinct Python processes against the same state directory and fixed gap set.
The first process is expected to attempt the first bounded gap and persist cursor 1; the second fresh process is expected to resume at the second gap and wrap the cursor to 0.
decisions: Treat module reload as insufficient evidence for process-restart recovery; require distinct OS process IDs.
Keep Gate 2 fail-closed unless exact-head CI proves this replay and the remaining #230 ownership/crash/bypass criteria are satisfied.
